In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], after the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established a '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]]. However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] followed the Rebels there, and they were forced to evacuate soon thereafter.
